title_en: The Yard Must Open: The Record

commands.text: The final chain drops. The gates stay open when the kiln arm turns.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: A door should not need someone crushed beneath it to remain a door.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: The binding is intact. Most slips are blank; three still carry letters.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: Enough to ask the families. Never enough to decide for them.
Beyond the yard, Oakhaven's ordinary lamps become visible through the gap.
